important_boundary: The list records independently published source descriptions; it does not mean any new corpus has been downloaded, manually audited or licensed for redistribution.

sources.title: Hindi Speech Corpus
sources.known_scope: word-level Hindi corpus, short vocabulary; 40 excerpted records held locally
sources.licensing: Repository states MIT; data-component rights must still be reviewed
sources.source_notes: Source-indexed excerpt; full upstream lexicon never independently reconciled in current release

sources.title: Arora, Gessler and Schneider (ACL 2020) schwa deletion
sources.known_scope: Hindi/Punjabi G2P and schwa-deletion classifiers and dictionaries
sources.licensing: Per-file dataset rights and derived dictionary redistribution not checked
sources.source_notes: Model-predicted alternatives must not be promoted to independently observed alternative pronunciations

sources.title: SargamBench (Zenodo 2026)
sources.known_scope: 1,026 lyric–Sargam pairs, ten Raag profiles, lyric–melody alignment; release explicitly excludes Taal
sources.licensing: Zenodo page rights section not resolved in inspection; review precise license before reuse
sources.source_notes: A lyric–melody sequence cannot be relabeled a Taal timing reference

sources.title: Expressive Timing in Hindustani Vocal Music (2025 IIT Bombay study)
sources.known_scope: Study reports 2,041 manually labeled syllable onsets from 14 recordings and eight singers in Teentaal; underlying annotation files not acquired here
sources.licensing: Supplementary data accessibility and redistribution permissions not verified
sources.source_notes: A relevant real lyric–rhythm dataset exists, but no alternate pronunciation gold has been established

sources.title: CompMusic Hindustani Rhythm Dataset
sources.known_scope: Manually marked progress through Hindustani Taal cycles; does not document co-indexed syllabified lyrics in source description
sources.licensing: Data license and access conditions must be checked before download
sources.source_notes: Taal data from unrelated performances cannot serve as gold alignments for arbitrary lyrics

claim_specs.scope: word-to-phone source transcription, not gold accuracy
symbolic lyric–melody reference, not Taal or song pronunciation variants
sung syllable onsets under a beat grid; not pronunciation variability
same word/item verified multiple pronunciations and their boundaries
all requirements must apply to the SAME evaluation instance, not independent corpora

integrity_rules: Never union different sources to assemble item-level ground truth without externally verified same-item linkage.
Presence of a published dataset is not proof that its bytes were acquired or its annotations independently checked.
A synthetic schwa deletion is not an independently attested pronunciation.
A G2P output is not an observed sung syllabification.
Licensing, checksum integrity and scientific validation are separate gates.
